planning_notes: The request for 2 HARD targets was fulfilled by selecting two distinct, high-complexity concepts from the available pool. Target 1 focuses on the 'Median of Two Sorted Arrays' problem, which is a canonical HARD application of Divide and Conquer and Binary Search, requiring complex index manipulation and edge case handling. Target 2 focuses on 'Time Complexity Analysis' specifically regarding the recurrence relation T(n) = T(n/2) + O(1), requiring students to derive the asymptotic bound and understand the mathematical rationale behind the O(log n) result, distinguishing it from linear or quadratic cases.
